headline: Get Bailite
title: How to Get Bailite | Evolve Cozite | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Bailite is one of the late game Rock Aniimo. You get it from Cozite, which you can catch in Zephyrus Landbridge. Cozite evolves into Bailite at level fifty one, one of the highest evolution levels in the game. There is no quest, time of day or place to visit, you just need the level. Is Bailite on your team? Comment below!
description: Cozite lives in Zephyrus Landbridge and evolves into Bailite at level 51, with no quest, time or location condition.
